metadata.title: Geologix Vanguard Group — Tender Monitoring Intelligence
metadata.description: Comprehensive tender portal landscape for SA industrial group covering mining services, logistics, energy, equipment rental, security, IT, and construction

national_portals.update_frequency: Real-time — procurement plans, advertisements, awards, and contracts published automatically once captured by government departments
national_portals.registration_required: No registration needed to browse; CSD registration (https://secure.csd.gov.za) mandatory to submit bids
national_portals.api_standard: OCDS (Open Contracting Data Standard) v1 — licensed Creative Commons BY 4.0
national_portals.bulk_download: Monthly XLSX/CSV/JSON files available from May 2021 at https://data.etenders.gov.za/Home/ReleasesFiles
national_portals.notes: Primary national procurement gazette. All national and provincial departments publish here. Municipal RFQs below R500k may not appear — use ProTenders for municipal coverage.

national_portals.update_frequency: Varies; tender notices tied to project registration updates
national_portals.registration_required: Mandatory CIDB grading (Grades 1–9) for all contractors bidding on public construction work. Registration via cidb.org.za.
national_portals.collection_method: Scrape-only — no public API or bulk download
veralogix_sectors_served: Veralogix Rentals (plant hire on CIDB-graded projects)
national_portals.notes: Mandatory for any company bidding on government construction work. Contractors must hold the correct CIDB grade matching contract value. Registration documents must include award letters and certificates of completion on client letterhead.

national_portals.update_frequency: Weekly bulletin; individual tenders posted on rolling basis
national_portals.registration_required: CSD registration mandatory first. Then vendor registration via Eskom's vendor portal (4–6 week processing time). Requirements: Company Registration Certificate, Tax Clearance Certificate, B-BBEE Certificate, Business Profile, ISO 9001 or equivalent SHEQ policy.
national_portals.collection_method: Scrape-only — tender search interface at tenderbulletin.eskom.co.za/search
national_portals.annual_procurement_spend: Eskom is the largest public procurer in South Africa — thousands of tenders annually
national_portals.notes: Eskom requires CSD registration before vendor portal registration. High-value engineering, plant maintenance, and infrastructure tenders. Watch for IPP (Independent Power Producer) related procurement.

national_portals.update_frequency: Continuous; new tenders posted as required by operating divisions
national_portals.registration_required: CSD registration mandatory. Then register on Transnet eSupplier Portal. Upload: B-BBEE certificate, tax clearance, company registration. Select commodity categories.
national_portals.collection_method: Scrape-only — unified portal covers Transnet SOC, Port Terminals, Freight Rail, Pipelines, Properties
national_portals.annual_procurement_spend: R50 billion+ annual procurement — one of SA's largest tender sources
veralogix_sectors_served: Coal Processors International (coal logistics, port operations)
national_portals.notes: All Transnet operating divisions now unified under the eSupplier Portal for digital submission. Critical for logistics-adjacent services.

national_portals.portal_name: DMPR (Department of Mineral Resources and Petroleum)
national_portals.update_frequency: Ad hoc — tenders published on rolling basis per procurement cycle
national_portals.registration_required: Submit to Procurement Officer, Private Bag X59, Arcadia 0007. Online submission where available.
national_portals.collection_method: Scrape-only — monitor dmpr.gov.za and aggregators (tenderalerts.co.za, easytenders.co.za)
national_portals.notes: Department rebranded from DMRE to DMPR (Department of Mineral Resources and Petroleum). Legacy URLs still redirect. Watch for regulatory compliance services tenders — high relevance for Mining Safety Services.

national_portals.update_frequency: Ad hoc per defence procurement cycle
national_portals.registration_required: Electronic supplier AND security registration mandatory. Facility Security Clearance (FSC) required for classified contracts — vetting takes 4+ months. Register early.
veralogix_sectors_served: Security Services (guarding, surveillance for defence facilities)
national_portals.notes: Primarily relevant for Security Services division. Requires Facility Security Clearance before any classified contract eligibility. Non-classified tenders (IT, logistics support) do not require FSC.

national_portals.update_frequency: Weekly via Government Gazette and online publication
national_portals.registration_required: CIDB grading for construction; CSD registration for all
national_portals.notes: Major source of infrastructure construction and facility management tenders. Also manages leases of state-owned buildings — relevant for security guarding contracts.

national_portals.portal_name: AEMFC (African Exploration Mining and Finance Corporation) — Open Tenders
national_portals.notes: State-owned mining company — coal-specific. Relevant for Coal Processors International and equipment rental.

national_portals.portal_name: SANRAL (South African National Roads Agency) — Open Tenders
national_portals.update_frequency: Continuous — tenders posted as advertised per SANRAL procurement cycle
national_portals.registration_required: CSD registration mandatory. CIDB grading required for road construction (CE class). Register on SANRAL eSDD for SMME 2nd-tier subcontracting opportunities.
national_portals.collection_method: Scrape-only — nra.co.za/sanral-tenders/list/open-tenders or via eTenders OCDS API (SANRAL also publishes to eTenders)
veralogix_sectors_served: Endeto Project Services (civil and structural engineering, bridge fabrication)
Veralogix Rentals (plant and equipment hire on road projects)
national_portals.notes: SANRAL manages the national road network (R millions per contract). Road construction, routine maintenance, professional services, and toll management tenders. 2nd-tier/SMME subcontracting available through SANRAL eSDD without going through full main-contractor tender process.

national_portals.portal_name: PRASA (Passenger Rail Agency of South Africa) — Procurement
national_portals.update_frequency: Ad hoc — per PRASA capital and maintenance procurement cycles
national_portals.registration_required: CSD registration mandatory. CIDB grading for construction works. Compulsory briefing sessions required before most PRASA tenders.
national_portals.collection_method: Scrape-only — monitor prasa.com/tenders and eTenders portal (PRASA publishes via eTenders for larger contracts)
veralogix_sectors_served: Endeto Project Services (rail infrastructure, steel fabrication for rolling stock maintenance facilities)
Veramani IT Division (passenger information and ICT systems)
Veralogix Rentals (construction equipment on station upgrades)
national_portals.notes: PRASA manages intercity rail (Shosholoza Meyl) and commuter rail (Metrorail). Massive station upgrade and rolling stock maintenance programme. Security tenders at stations are large multi-year contracts. Strict documentation and compulsory briefings — factor in lead time.

national_portals.registration_required: CSD registration. Vendor registration via ACSA procurement portal.
national_portals.collection_method: Scrape-only — also captured on eTenders for formal tenders
veralogix_sectors_served: Security Services (airport security guarding and access control)
Endeto Project Services (terminal construction and maintenance)
Veralogix Rentals (airfield and terminal construction equipment)
national_portals.notes: ACSA manages OR Tambo, Cape Town, King Shaka, and six smaller airports. Facilities management, security guarding, ICT, and construction tenders. Airport-specific PSIRA licensing required for security guarding.

national_portals.portal_name: DBSA (Development Bank of Southern Africa) — Tenders
national_portals.update_frequency: Ad hoc per project financing cycle
national_portals.registration_required: CSD registration. Register on DBSA Central Supplier Database via dbsa.org/central-supplier-database.
national_portals.collection_method: Scrape-only — also published in national newspapers and eTenders
veralogix_sectors_served: Energy/Solar (renewable energy project finance and EPC tendering)
Endeto Project Services (engineering services on DBSA-funded infrastructure)
national_portals.notes: DBSA finances municipal infrastructure (water, energy, transport, housing) and often procures engineering and construction services directly for projects it implements. Strong renewable energy and water infrastructure pipeline. Check DBSA separately — not all tenders appear on eTenders.

national_portals.registration_required: CSD registration. IDC does not maintain a separate supplier database — direct tender submission to IDC procurement team.
national_portals.collection_method: Scrape-only — monitor idc.co.za/tenders/ and eTenders portal
veralogix_sectors_served: Veramani IT Division (ICT services for financial institution)
national_portals.notes: IDC provides development finance and also procures services directly. Lower volume than DBSA but relevant for green economy and mining beneficiation project services. IDC also funds Veralogix Group companies — dual relationship opportunity.

mining_house_portals.platform: SAP Ariba (Ariba Network + Supplier Lifecycle & Performance module)
mining_house_portals.registration_process: 1. Register on SAP Ariba Network. 2. Complete Supplier Lifecycle & Performance (SLP) profile. 3. Submit B-BBEE certificate, tax clearance, company registration. 4. Anglo American reviews and approves vendor.
veralogix_companies_applicable: Endeto Project Services (engineering, fabrication, maintenance shutdowns)
Mining Safety Services (contractor safety management, MHSA compliance)
mining_house_portals.notes: Inclusive procurement policy targets black-, female-, youth-owned businesses. Operates Zimele enterprise development programme with hubs near operations.

mining_house_portals.platform: SAP Ariba (shared Anglo American group platform)
mining_house_portals.registration_process: Register via Anglo American group Ariba portal. Kumba-specific commodity categories for iron ore operations (Sishen, Kolomela mines in Northern Cape).
mining_house_portals.key_operations: Sishen Mine (Northern Cape), Kolomela Mine (Northern Cape)
mining_house_portals.notes: Iron ore only. Two flagship mines in Northern Cape. Maintenance shutdowns and plant services are significant procurement categories.

mining_house_portals.registration_process: Register online at implats.co.za. Ariba-based supplier lifecycle management. Linked to Enterprise and Supplier Development (ESD) department and Business Development Centre at Marula Operations.
mining_house_portals.key_operations: Impala Rustenburg, Marula (Limpopo), Two Rivers (Mpumalanga), Zimplats (Zimbabwe)
mining_house_portals.notes: Economic Inclusion Centre at Impala Rustenburg supports local SMME supplier development.

mining_house_portals.registration_process: 1. Complete online supplier registration form at sibanyestillwater.com/suppliers/south-africa/. 2. Attach B-BBEE and Tax Clearance Certificates. 3. Submit all required profile data. Support: portalsupport@sibanyestillwater.com / 011 278 9600.
mining_house_portals.key_operations: Kloof, Driefontein, Beatrix (gold, Gauteng/FS), Rustenburg Platinum Mines, Marikana (Cooke), Kroondal
mining_house_portals.notes: Largest gold producer in SA and significant PGM player. High volume of maintenance, safety, and equipment rental procurement.

mining_house_portals.platform: Glencore proprietary portal (separate portals for Coal and Ferroalloys operations)
mining_house_portals.registration_process: Register online at glencore.com/south-africa/suppliers. Separate portals for Coal operations (Mpumalanga/KZN) and Ferroalloys (Limpopo). Preference for local, black-owned businesses near operations.
mining_house_portals.key_operations: Mpumalanga coal mines (Tweefontein, Impunzi, Goedgevonden), Merafe Ferrochrome JV (Limpopo), Lydenburg Smelters
mining_house_portals.notes: One of SA's largest coal exporters. Proximity-based preference — operations concentrated in Mpumalanga/Limpopo.

mining_house_portals.platform: Gold Fields proprietary supplier registration system
mining_house_portals.registration_process: Register via goldfields.com/supplier-registration.php. Submit company details, B-BBEE certificate, tax clearance.
mining_house_portals.key_operations: South Deep Mine (Westonaria, Gauteng — world's second deepest mine)
mining_house_portals.notes: SA operations currently limited to South Deep (Gold Fields exited other SA mines). Deep-level mining requires specialist safety and engineering services.

mining_house_portals.registration_process: Register as SMME supplier via harmonyprocure.com. Preferential procurement policy with targets for local and HDI suppliers.
mining_house_portals.key_operations: Moab Khotsong, Doornkop, Kusasalethu, Masimong, Tshepong (Free State, Gauteng), Hidden Valley (Papua New Guinea)
mining_house_portals.notes: SA's largest gold producer by volume (underground). Strong SMME focus — accessible entry point for group companies.

mining_house_portals.registration_process: CSD registration required first. Then register via Sasol's supplier portal. Sasol uses integrated CSD data for supplier verification.
mining_house_portals.key_operations: Sasol Mining (Mpumalanga coal mines), Secunda Synfuels (world's largest coal-to-liquid plant), Natref Refinery
veralogix_companies_applicable: Coal Processors International (coal supply, plant operations)
Endeto Project Services (shutdown maintenance at Secunda)
mining_house_portals.notes: Secunda is one of SA's largest single industrial procurement sites. Plant shutdown contracts are high-value. Coal supply chain services directly relevant to Coal Processors International.

mining_house_portals.registration_process: Submit supplier registration application via northam.co.za. Procurement team reviews and approves qualified suppliers.
mining_house_portals.key_operations: Zondereinde Mine (Limpopo — deepest platinum mine), Booysendal (Limpopo/Mpumalanga)
mining_house_portals.notes: Significant PGM producer. Zondereinde is deepest platinum mine — specialist safety and vertical transport requirements.

mining_house_portals.registration_process: Register via arm.co.za. ARM operates through joint ventures — supplier registration may need to be done at JV level (e.g., Assmang).
mining_house_portals.key_operations: Modikwa Platinum (Limpopo), Two Rivers Platinum (Mpumalanga), Khumani Iron Ore (Northern Cape), Beeshoek Iron Ore, Nkomati Nickel (Mpumalanga), Gloria/Goedgevonden Coal (Mpumalanga)
mining_house_portals.notes: Diversified miner across multiple commodities. Manganese and chrome operations in Northern Cape and Limpopo offer equipment rental and maintenance opportunities.

mining_house_portals.platform: Exxaro Common Supplier Portal (CSP) via Microsoft CRM portal — invitation required to register
mining_house_portals.registration_process: 1. Request invitation via exxaro.com/suppliers. 2. Complete Common Supplier Portal (CSP) registration with B-BBEE certificate, company registration, tax clearance, banking details. 3. Select commodity categories relevant to your business. 4. Await approval.
mining_house_portals.key_operations: Grootegeluk (Lephalale, Limpopo — largest coal mine in SA), Matimba and Medupi power station supply, Belfast (Mpumalanga), Mafube JV (Mpumalanga), ECC (Thabametsi future project)
veralogix_companies_applicable: Coal Processors International (coal processing plant operations and management)
Mining Safety Services (MHSA compliance at large surface coal operations)
Endeto Project Services (plant fabrication and maintenance at Grootegeluk)
Veralogix Rentals (heavy equipment at open-cast coal mine)
Veramani IT Division (ICT infrastructure at remote mine sites)
mining_house_portals.notes: Exxaro is SA's largest pure-play coal producer. Grootegeluk is the country's largest coal mine by output. Very high-volume procurement programme. Strong BEE and ESD focus with preference for local suppliers near operations.

mining_house_portals.registration_process: Register via south32.net/suppliers. Complete supplier profile with B-BBEE certificate, tax clearance, CIDB registration (where applicable), company registration.
commodities: Coal (South Africa Energy Coal — transferred to Seriti Resources)
mining_house_portals.key_operations: Hillside Aluminium Smelter (Richards Bay, KZN), Mozal Aluminium (Mozambique), Samancor Chrome / Merafe Chrome JV, Metalloys Manganese Smelter (Johannesburg South)
veralogix_companies_applicable: Endeto Project Services (smelter fabrication and maintenance, furnace rebuilds at Hillside and Metalloys)
Mining Safety Services (MHSA compliance for smelter and processing plant)
Veralogix Rentals (heavy equipment and crane hire for smelter maintenance)
Veramani IT Division (ICT for remote smelter and aluminium plant operations)
mining_house_portals.notes: South32's aluminium and manganese smelter operations require frequent scheduled maintenance and furnace rebuilds — high-value fabrication and maintenance scope. Richards Bay (Hillside) and Johannesburg South (Metalloys) are primary SA locations.

municipal_portals.update_frequency: Continuous — new tenders and RFQs posted as advertised
municipal_portals.notes: Largest metro by GDP. High volume of tenders across all service categories. JDA (Johannesburg Development Agency) publishes separately at jda.org.za.
National capital — high concentration of government procurement. Municipal entities (TshwaneAgri, TRT) have separate procurement.

municipal_portals.municipality_name: City of Cape Town Metropolitan Municipality
municipal_portals.update_frequency: Continuous — registration required to view RFQs under R200k
municipal_portals.notes: Cape Town has sophisticated online portal. RFQs below R200k require supplier registration. Strong solar and renewable energy pipeline.
Home to Africa's busiest port. High construction and infrastructure procurement pipeline. MBDA (Mandela Bay Development Agency equivalent for Durban is EDTEA) has separate tenders.
East Rand industrial heartland — largest concentration of manufacturing in Africa. High demand for industrial security, ICT and construction services.
Port Elizabeth and Gqeberha — automotive and port city. MBDA publishes additional development agency tenders.

municipal_portals.update_frequency: Weekly PDF summary of quotes and tenders
municipal_portals.notes: Bloemfontein metro. Gateway to Northern Cape and Free State mining regions. Weekly PDF tender summary published.

municipal_portals.update_frequency: Continuous — formal tenders, RFQs, tender openings and awards published
municipal_portals.notes: East London/King William's Town metro. Industrial zone and IDZ (Industrial Development Zone) procurement.

Witbank/eMalahleni is the coal mining capital of SA — overlaps directly with Coal Processors International and Veralogix Rentals target market. High municipal infrastructure procurement driven by mining economy.
Platinum hub — Impala, Anglo Platinum, Sibanye-Stillwater all operate nearby. Significant municipal infrastructure investment driven by mining royalties.
Limpopo capital — gateway to platinum and chrome mining belt. Growing municipal infrastructure pipeline.
Vereeniging/Vanderbijlpark — steel and heavy industry zone. ArcelorMittal SA proximity creates demand for industrial services.
Kimberley — diamond mining and Northern Cape hub. Proximity to Kumba iron ore operations (Sishen/Kolomela). Growing solar/renewable energy procurement.
KZN provincial capital. Significant municipal infrastructure spend. Gateway to midlands logistics and coal trucking corridor.
Fast-growing Western Cape municipality. Strong renewable energy and solar installation pipeline. Part of Cape Winelands and agro-industrial corridor.

aggregators.recommended_for: Veralogix Group primary free monitoring tool — broadest coverage, no cost

aggregators.cost_model: Free browsing; paid email alert subscription
aggregators.coverage: ~5,000 tenders — SA government, state departments, state-owned companies
aggregators.recommended_for: Mining sector-specific monitoring (mining support service activities category)

aggregators.cost_model: Free basic registration; paid premium plans
aggregators.coverage: 140,000+ global notices including SA — sourced from government gazettes, procurement boards, development banks
features: Past tender and contract award data
aggregators.recommended_for: Mining-sector monitoring — especially Veralogix Rentals and Coal Processors International; also useful for benchmarking past contract awards

aggregators.coverage: 1,000+ new tenders and RFQs added weekly; national and provincial coverage
features: Issuer-specific alerts (e.g., per municipality or department)

aggregators.coverage: South African government tenders across all levels
SA government tenders — national, provincial, municipal
aggregators.recommended_for: Inbox-based workflow for field staff with limited time for portal browsing

aggregators.coverage: Global + SA-specific; mining and minerals sector category
aggregators.recommended_for: Exporting divisions or international tender monitoring; secondary to ProTenders for domestic SA use

data_format_assessment.summary: Only the National Treasury eTenders portal exposes a true programmatic API. All other portals require HTML scraping or manual monitoring.
data_format_assessment.collection_strategy_recommendation: Build a hybrid system: (1) Pull eTenders data via OCDS API for national government tenders; (2) Subscribe to ProTenders and TendersOnTime for aggregated municipal and mining tenders; (3) Scrape Eskom Tender Bulletin and Transnet portal weekly; (4) Monitor mining house portals via manual quarterly review plus Ariba/Coupa notification emails.

Medium — HTML scraping; login may be required for full tender access

portals.automation_feasibility: Low — requires Coupa registered supplier account
